scope: Persistent client challenge lifecycle and authenticated holder revision/checkpoint floor. Three added files; accepted holder/recovery/witness bytes unchanged. No network transport or server request authorization is implemented.
mechanism: Trusted bootstrap binds client/holder/witness/instance, initial revision and witness-authenticated checkpoint; it is not receiving-derived enrollment
Distinct client journal/challenge, holder snapshot and witness checkpoint keys
HMAC-derived domain-bound monotonically numbered challenges; ISSUE full-write/fsync before exposing nonce
Verify accepted holder snapshot against exact active nonce and binding; reject pending holder uncertainty; authenticate embedded witness checkpoint independently
Reject revision and checkpoint-height regression, same-revision checkpoint substitution, same-height fork, and advanced stable revision without witness progress
ACCEPT stores exact authenticated snapshot and advances durable floor before positive return; journal replay reauthenticates the evidence
Clean restart reconstructs floor and challenge ordinal; pending request from prior session cannot accept/resume/refill
freshness_contract: A response is authenticated and correlated to a durably issued challenge. Acceptance establishes a persisted lower bound on holder revision/checkpoint for later reads, not a lease or proof of latest global state at response arrival. Subsequent mutations still require holder-side exact CAS. Same revision with byte-identical checkpoint is valid under a new challenge. The accepted holder/recovery stable-state progression is assumed; future consumption/rollover protocols require separate compatibility review.
uncertainty: Any accept error terminally poisons the active client. Persisted but unacknowledged ACCEPT reconstructs its floor on reopen; if uncertain ACCEPT bytes disappear, preceding durable ISSUE remains pending and blocks continuation. An ISSUE persistence error exposes no nonce. No reset/resume/refill or journal recreation recovery API exists.
trust_limits: Client journal must be independently provisioned durable nonrollback storage. This implementation cannot detect rollback of its own entire journal, copied client roots, or simultaneous client/holder/witness rollback. Challenge nonreuse is conditional on retained client history and unique provisioned client identity/key.
flock coordinates the same inode only; PID checks reject inherited object use. Neither is distributed clone fencing or global enrollment.
Trusted private namespace/kernel/fsync and no privileged same-size in-place rewrite; no exhaustive power-loss or production storage-root acceptance.

Provisioning/bootstrap and key custody are trusted external inputs. Client possesses symmetric verification keys; MACs prove key possession, not nonrepudiation or remote server attestation. No production secrets are generated or deployed.
Holder snapshot API remains read-only and unauthenticated on its request side; this component does not deploy transport, TLS, server authorization or endpoint isolation.
Client and holder APIs remain bypassable by trusted process code. Direct witness bypass prevention is not implemented.
No continuous lifetime enforcement, VM provenance, full entry-path/hidden-input closure, derivative toolchain, immutable platform, canonical manifest or complete admission acceptance.
qualification: 32 new deterministic excluded synthetic unittest methods, local attempt 1 PASS: positive repeated reads, durable floors/restart and accepted recovery progress, challenge replay/duplicate/unsolicited/pending restart, eight-way issue race, holder uncertainty, revision/height/equivocation/key/instance/bootstrap/malformed attacks, fsync and lost ACCEPT bytes, corrupt ordering/partial/missing journal, second writer/symlink/fork, short/zero write. No unchanged predecessor suite rerun.
gate: Independent Reviewer B exact-source and qualification review then orchestrator adoption. No official entropy/seeds/allocations/claims/gameplay/outcomes/sealed worker/R1 authority.
